parameters.query: WITH dia_stats AS (SELECT COUNT(*) as total_triajes, AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (updated_at - created_at))/60) as tiempo_promedio, COUNT(CASE WHEN nivel_urgencia_final IN ('RED','ORANGE') THEN 1 END) as criticos FROM triajes WHERE DATE(created_at) = CURRENT_DATE AND activo = true), discrepancia_stats AS (SELECT COUNT(*) as discrepancia_count FROM triajes WHERE DATE(created_at) = CURRENT_DATE AND nivel_urgencia_asignado_ia != nivel_urgencia_final AND activo = true) SELECT json_build_object('fecha', CURRENT_DATE, 'total_triajes', d.total_triajes, 'tiempo_promedio', ROUND(d.tiempo_promedio::numeric, 2), 'criticos', d.criticos, 'discrepancias', s.discrepancia_count, 'tasa_concurrencia', ROUND(((d.total_triajes - s.discrepancia_count)::numeric / NULLIF(d.total_triajes, 0) * 100), 1)) as reporte FROM dia_stats d, discrepancia_stats s;
